what: The preference route's two draws: the paired conversion against the archived control, split by whether the prompt changed, with the cost that came with it and the set of questions each draw converted.
why: The numbers are read off two 60 MB artifacts that are not in this repository, so the reading could not be re-derived inside `pnpm check`. What the test beside it does enforce is the arithmetic that has to hold between the numbers -- a delta that does not equal its own bucket sum is how a round reports +7 next to a +8 movement -- and the identity of the two draws' conversion sets, which is the claim a mean cannot make.

control.note: the same artifact, filtered to the 150 questions the treatment ran; a 500-question roster cannot be paired against a 150-question one, and `--attribution` refuses it

draw2.note: the same twenty-two inputs as draw 1, dispatched again after the balance was topped up; draw 1's confirmation dispatch 45301338541 died in its embedding preflight with 429

audit.untouchedByThePopulation: none of the nine is in the 30, and all 30 carry promptVariants 1

attributable.note: the attributable delta is the changed bucket's 7 - 2 = +5; the total movement is 8 - 2 = 6 and the difference is the reach guard's single flip on a prompt whose bytes never moved

replication.whyItIsTheStrongStatement: ten wrong questions, seven chosen twice, the same seven: a mean cannot say that, and noise does not pick the same seven twice

theTwoLostAreExplainedByDelivery.note: both are among the four whose delivered turn count changed between the archive and the treatment (18 -> 17 and 49 -> 48); the seven stable conversions carry identical promptChars, evidenceChars, turn count and turnWindowCensus with deliveredPromptChars +125 exactly
